journey.name: create profile after signup
journey.description: Precondition: a disposable, unfunded fresh wallet with Paykit enabled, no existing Pubky identity, a reachable staging Pubky signup site and an English device. Open the signup site in a browser and keep the app process alive throughout this journey. This iOS journey checks profile creation after an external signup authorization.

actions.action: Open staging.pubky.app in the browser, begin signup and copy the pubkyauth://signup link
Open Bitkit Scan, paste the signup link and verify the signup authorization sheet appears
Tap Authorize and wait for signup authorization to complete
Return to the browser and verify the site has continued with the authorized public Pubky key; record that key
Return to Bitkit and wait for Create Profile to finish loading
Enter "Test" in the username field (identifier "CreateProfileUsername") and dismiss the keyboard
Tap Continue (identifier "CreateProfileSave") and wait for profile creation to finish
Verify no Profile Error toast appears when profile creation completes
Open Profile and verify it shows "Test" and the same public Pubky key recorded from the signup site
Return Home and reopen Profile; verify the new profile is still available without restarting the app
